extracted.intended_audience: Colorado State University students and faculty seeking research funding and proposal support
extracted.subtask_description: A directory page from the CSU Office of the Vice President for Research listing internal and external funding opportunities and offices that provide proposal development and grant-writing support for faculty and students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office mission: enhance the research climate at Colorado State University
rubrics_metrics.description: A fundamental goal of the Office of the Vice President for Research is to enhance the research climate at Colorado State University.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We are here to help students and faculty in all disciplines by generating internal and external funding for scholarly and creative activities. In addition to funding opportunities, the Office of the Vice President provides grant writing resources, proposal development services, and technical assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal Funding Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists internal funding programs administered or publicized by the OVPR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs listed on the page: FY21 Research Continuity Fund (OUTDATED); Quarterly Strategic Investment; Research Core Facilities; Catalyst for Innovative Partnerships (OUTDATED); Pre-Catalyst for Innovative Partnerships (OUTDATED); OVPR Anschutz Pandemic Resilience and Graduate Fellowship Programs (OUTDATED).

rubrics_metrics.name: External Funding Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Pointers to external funding sources and search mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Items listed: Limited Submission; Grants.gov; SPIN (OUTDATED); Corporate Relations and Foundation Relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal Development Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Offices that provide support for preparing and submitting proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named offices: Office of Sponsored Programs; Research Acceleration Office. These offices provide proposal development support (e.g., administrative support, submission assistance, compliance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Resources for Grantseeking
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional informational resources for finding and pursuing grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed resource: Corporate & Foundation Relations (also referenced under External Funding Opportunities). These resources complement OVPR services and help identify corporate/foundation funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Mentoring Plan Templates for Advisors
rubrics_metrics.description: Templates and materials to support mentoring plans related to grants and trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists 'Grant Mentoring Plan Templates for Advisors' as a resource item (no further details on this page).
